issues.detail: The Hebrew 'עַתָּה יָבֹא דְבָרֶיךָ' means 'Now let your words come to pass' (a statement of expectation/desire that the words be fulfilled), but the Vietnamese 'Nguyện các lời của ngài bây giờ được ứng nghiệm' adds 'Nguyện' (may/let it be so), which is an optative addition not present in the Hebrew. The Hebrew is a simple future/declarative 'will come', not a prayer/optative. This changes the nuance from a confident statement to a wish.
